summary.intent: Insert a new decimal phase (19.2) for IPFS upload performance optimization based on findings from Phase 19 baselines, then research and plan the phase.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 was inserted into the roadmap, researched (RESEARCH.md written), a validation strategy created (VALIDATION.md written), and the planner was spawned. The researcher corrected a misconception in the baselines document about which pins could be parallelized.

repo: Phase 19.1 already existed (SDK extraction), making the performance optimization phase 19.2
The gsd-tools CLI handles decimal phase numbering and directory creation but may insert phases in incorrect order in the roadmap file, requiring manual reordering
The load test infrastructure (tests/load/ vitest suite with mixed-workload and upload-throughput scenarios) was already built in Phase 19 and produces JSON metrics reports with percentile breakdowns
Prometheus histograms cipherbox_ipfs_ipns_duration_seconds already capture server-side pin timing
The IPFS upload flow has 5 sequential pin/publish calls with ~1.73s each; steps 2+3 are parallelizable but steps 1a+1b are not due to CID dependency

code.finding: Primary parallelization opportunity is ~10-line change to wrap two sequential awaits in Promise.allSettled for steps 2+3 of upload flow (file IPNS batch publish + folder metadata update)

workflow: The baselines document contained an incorrect analysis — it suggested pins 1+2 could be parallelized, but the researcher's direct code tracing revealed steps 1a+1b have a CID dependency making only steps 2+3 parallelizable
gsd:insert-phase tool may insert decimal phases in wrong order in ROADMAP.md, requiring manual edit correction after insertion
Git worktrees can be created off main for parallel phase work while feature branches handle the current phase
pebbleds is the recommended Kubo datastore alternative (badgerds is deprecated/scheduled for removal); no benchmarks exist for pebbleds vs flatfs v0.40.0 so empirical testing is needed

friction: gsd-tools inserted phase 19.2 before 19.1 in the ROADMAP.md file, requiring manual reordering via multiple Edit tool calls
The baselines document contained incorrect parallelization analysis that had to be corrected by the researcher through direct source code tracing
open_items: Planner agent (gsd-planner) was spawned but transcript ends before planning completes — PLAN.md files not yet created

Empirical testing needed: whether 2 concurrent pin requests per upload from API hits Kubo internal write locks
Empirical testing needed: whether IPFS_PROFILE=server,pebbleds correctly composes both profiles
